fileInjection:
  - path: "/etc/chrony.conf"
    fileMode: "0644"
    fileOwner: "root:root"
    postAction: "systemctl enable chronyd && systemctl restart chronyd"
    content: |
      server 172.19.254.12
      driftfile /var/lib/chrony/drift
      makestep 1.0 3
      rtcsync
      ntsdumpdir /var/lib/chrony
      logdir /var/log/chrony

  - path: /etc/sysctl.d/99-tca-node-customization.conf
    fileMode: "0644"
    fileOwner: "root:root"
    postAction: "systemctl restart systemd-sysctl"
    content: |
      vm.max_map_count = 262144

  - path: /etc/modules-load.d/99-tca-node-customization.conf
    fileMode: "0644"
    fileOwner: "root:root"
    postAction: "systemctl restart systemd-modules-load"
    content: |
      sctp

  - path: "/root/custom_script.sh"
    fileMode: "0750"
    fileOwner: "root:root"
    postAction: "/root/custom_script.sh"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      mkdir -p -m 700 /var/lib/consul
      chown 100:1000 /var/lib/consul

templates.name: template.yaml
templates.resources:
#@ load("@ytt:data", "data")

kind: NodePolicy
spec: #@ data.values.raw_nodepolicy_spec.spec
